title: Character Expanded Metadata Schema
description: Metadata for an expanded character data structure, tracking versioning and source information for round-trip conversions.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the expanded data format. Used for migration detection. v2 adds the 'textures' array for direct-pipeline roundtrip support.

expandedAtUtc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the data was expanded.

dataFormat.description: Serialization format used for expanded data files.

sourceFile.description: Path to the original source file (.znelchar or character.json) if known.

sourceHashSha256.description: SHA256 hash of the source file for change detection. 64 hex characters.

characterName.description: Character name extracted from base.yaml for quick reference.

notes.description: Optional user notes about this expansion.

textures.description: Ordered texture name map for direct-pipeline roundtrip. Present only when expanded from a .znelchar file (schema v2+). Each entry maps the original _textureName from _textureDatas to the filename written into textures/.

file.description: Filename of the texture file written into textures/ during expansion.
